description: Catalog of skills, collections, and plugin bundles distributable from this repo.

skills.name: agent-credential-leak-surfaces
skills.summary: Find and clean the seven local surfaces where a coding agent accumulates copies of your secrets (git remote URLs, memory stores, file-history snapshots, tool config literals, permission allowlists, tool-output caches, and OS credential stores a filesystem sweep cannot see). Covers why prefix-grep gives false confidence, why a prefix-anchored pattern needs a left boundary, and why keyword-adjacency redaction loses to prose.

skills.name: agent-session-credential-audit
skills.summary: Triage, rotate and scrub credentials that leaked into agent session transcripts: the surfaces a naive scan misses, the false-positive taxonomy, the key-id-vs-secret severity test, five ways a liveness probe lies and the known-bad control that catches them, verifying a rotation actually rotated, identifying live-writer sessions, and a kill-list scrub that cannot erase a live secret and is verified by fingerprint rather than pattern count.

skills.name: agent-team-orchestration
skills.summary: Run a team of agents over a repo's open issues: architect plans the parallel set, per-issue squads (dev + adversarial reviewer + SDET + productivity engineer), each individually watchable.

skills.name: aws-http-server-on-lambda-web-adapter
skills.summary: Host an unmodified HTTP server (incl. LLM-proxy demos) as a scale-to-zero Lambda via the Web Adapter; Function-URL-403 fallback to API Gateway and its 30s-cap latency tradeoff; cost guardrails.

skills.name: claude-code-codex-plugin-parity
skills.summary: Port a Claude Code plugin to the Codex CLI (or back); where the two plugin systems match vs diverge, and the shared hooks.json caveats.

skills.name: claude-code-plugin-from-existing-repo
skills.summary: Convert a repo that ships Claude Code commands/hooks (manual copy-in) into an installable plugin without breaking manual install.

skills.name: claude-code-plugin-publish-anthropic-marketplace
skills.summary: Publish a Claude Code plugin to Anthropic's plugin marketplace, including the pre-submission validation pass.

skills.name: claude-code-plugin-python-bootstrap
skills.summary: Bootstrap Python deps from a Claude Code plugin hook so /plugin install is one-click on systems lacking them (PEP 668-safe).

skills.name: claude-code-plugin-update-flow
skills.summary: Why `claude plugin update` reports "up to date" while the plugin still runs stale code: the install cache is keyed by plugin.json#version. Authors bump on every shipping merge; verify against the cache dir, never the marketplace clone.

skills.name: claude-code-plugin-release-automation
skills.summary: Tag and publish release notes automatically from a plugin repo's manifest version, with CI enforcing the bump.

skills.name: claude-json-mcp-migration-slice
skills.summary: Identify the exact ~/.claude.json slice that carries MCP config for cross-machine migration vs session bookkeeping.

skills.name: claudeception
skills.summary: Continuous-learning meta-skill for both hosts: extract verified, reusable knowledge. Repeatable procedures become catalog skills via PR; specific recollections go to memory (local or a shared git-backed vault). Owns the catalog Wiring procedure - catalog.json, per-host bundle symlinks, the optional single-skill plugin, and the version bumps CI requires. Invoked explicitly; the Codex hook-driven entry point is `continuous-learning`.

skills.name: cmux-agent-tabs
skills.summary: Make AI agents show as watchable cmux tabs; Claude needs the claude-teams wrapper, Codex tabs via codex-teams/hooks.

skills.name: cmux-autoresume-after-reboot
skills.summary: Diagnose why cmux does not resume agent sessions after a macOS reboot even though terminal.autoResumeAgentSessions is enabled.

skills.name: cmux-search
skills.summary: Search all open cmux workspaces/tabs/panes - live scrollback + agent transcripts.

skills.name: codex-adversarial-pr-review
skills.summary: Post /codex:adversarial-review findings as a batched GitHub PR review (inline + out-of-diff rollup); sweep a whole PR backlog and post the saved payloads without a second Codex pass.

skills.name: confluence-rovo-mcp-readonly-rest-fallback
skills.summary: Create or update a Confluence Cloud page when the Atlassian Rovo connector is read-only: the REST v2 fallback, probing which API-token env var actually works, resolving a numeric spaceId from a personal-space key, and the HTML+ to storage-format conversion table (including the named-entity parse trap). Also covers editing an existing macro-bearing page without destroying it - rewriting such a body through the MCP returns 200 and silently drops the macros, so the safe path is a surgical string replacement on the storage-format body.

skills.name: continuous-learning
skills.summary: Run the end-of-task retrospective that Codex's `Stop` and `UserPromptSubmit` hooks demand, and decide what the session actually produced. Most turns end with `No reusable learning.` Of the rest, most are **memory** — a single cause->fix, an API gotcha, a config detail — and must NOT become a `SKILL.md`; only a repeatable procedure does. Use when a `Stop` hook fires at end-of-task, when a debugging-heavy session ends, or when the user asks "what did we learn?". Covers the four gates (discovery cost, recurrence, verifiable trigger, verified result), the skill-vs-memory classification, the install-location choice, and the `No reusable learning.` escape hatch. For an explicitly invoked retrospective, and for the wiring that promotes a skill into the `voitta-ai/skillz` catalog, see `claudeception` — this skill defers to it rather than restating it.

skills.name: gh-pr-merge-delete-branch-closes-dependent-pr
skills.summary: Stacked PRs: merging the upstream PR with branch deletion AUTO-CLOSES the dependent PR instead of retargeting it, and gh pr reopen then fails because the base ref is gone; recover by recreating the ref, or prevent by retargeting downstream PRs first

skills.name: gist-to-repo-migration
skills.summary: Migrate a gist's full revision history into a real git repo, preserving commits.

skills.name: git-graft-worktree-onto-remote
skills.summary: Graft a local worktree's commits onto a remote branch without re-cloning.

skills.name: git-pr-merge-unblock
skills.summary: Work out why a pull request will not merge and who can actually unblock it, on github.com or self-hosted GitHub Enterprise. Covers the states with no error message: bot approvals satisfy nothing CODEOWNERS checks so a PR reads approved and green while reviewDecision stays REVIEW_REQUIRED, a teams-only reviewer request notifies no individual, CODEOWNERS is matched per-path so a repo-wide owner answer is usually wrong, and the highest-yield reviewer is the changed file's recent author.

skills.name: git-worktree-convention
skills.summary: Keep every repo on its default branch with branch work in a sibling <repo>.worktrees/ dir; detect drift, ask before reorganizing, and recover from a repo on a branch, an ad-hoc worktree path, or a worktree nested inside the repo.

skills.name: github-actions-startup-failure-triage
skills.summary: Tell a GitHub Actions outage apart from a workflow file you broke, and get the PR unstuck without bypassing branch protection. Covers the three-signal test (actions/runs says completed/startup_failure while check-runs still says queued; zero jobs and zero annotations; .github/workflows untouched by the diff), the githubstatus summary.json one-liner that confirms it, close/reopen as the retrigger that adds no commit, and why a required check that never ran is a reason to wait rather than to force-merge.

skills.name: istio-multicluster-endpointless-mesh-service
skills.summary: Istio multi-cluster endpoint-less away-Service: use a decoy selector (not an omitted one) so an EndpointSlice anchor exists for the mesh to merge remote endpoints into; for cross-region write-routing / home-away Service topologies.

skills.name: macos-sparkle-update-quarantine-relaunch
skills.summary: Fix macOS Sparkle updater error 4005 / 'Failed to create installation cache directory' that persists after stripping quarantine: relaunch the un-quarantined bundle.

skills.name: multi-phase-feature-pr-worktrees
skills.summary: Run a multi-phase feature as stacked worktree PRs so each phase reviews independently.

skills.name: neon-vercel-db-identify-and-migrate
skills.summary: Identify which Neon project backs a Vercel app and migrate/split it; pg_dump>=server; safe non-destructive cutover.

skills.name: openclaw-model-cascade-debugging
skills.summary: Diagnose OpenClaw model-cascade failures (gateway process up but every run FailoverErrors because all providers are down), build a free OpenRouter fallback basket to survive codex cooldowns, and verify with one-shot `openclaw agent`.

skills.name: playwright-mcp-upload-hidden-file-input
skills.summary: Upload a file via Playwright MCP when the input is hidden: unhide+tag via evaluate, upload by id, verify via CDN/S3 URL.

skills.name: pre-open-source-credential-audit
skills.summary: Audit a git repo for leaked secrets before making it public: scan tracked files AND full history, avoid the git grep -E word-boundary false-negative, catch tracked editor-backup files, and decide rewrite+rotate vs. accept an inert identifier.

skills.name: prevent-committing-secrets
skills.summary: Block a credential at commit time with a gitleaks pre-commit hook, and cover new repos automatically via init.templateDir. The six paths that skip the hook, where the default ruleset is blind, why a staged-diff scan is not a history scan, and GitHub push protection plus CI as the halves that cannot be bypassed locally.

skills.name: python-ast-static-analyzer-scoping
skills.summary: Build a Python ast analyzer that resolves import aliases and models module-load vs deferred execution.

skills.name: review-pr-loop
skills.summary: Reviewer-side PR iteration loop.

skills.name: secrets-in-agent-sessions
skills.summary: Handle credentials during a coding-agent session without writing them into the transcript, tool-output cache, permission allowlist or logs. Fingerprint comparison, ask-the-service identification, and env-to-file transfer that never passes through the model.

skills.name: slack-app-token-rotation
skills.summary: Actually rotate a leaked Slack bot or app-level token: reinstalling does NOT mint a new xoxb-, only destroying the OAuth grant does. Covers the channel-membership fallout, the incoming-webhook channel picker, and verification without printing tokens.

skills.name: slack-xoxc-session-client
skills.summary: Drive the Slack web API as yourself via a live browser session (xoxc token + httpOnly d cookie) when you cannot install a Slack app; ships a runnable Python client that self-labels agent posts by default.

skills.name: terraform-ecs-capacity-provider-staged-teardown
skills.summary: Tear down an ECS-on-EC2 capacity-provider stack when one apply deadlocks with ResourceInUseException: destroy order is reverse-dependency, so compute tears down before the workload; split into two sequential untargeted applies, workload first

skills.name: terraform-state-version-apply-forensics
skills.summary: Prove a terraform change really was applied to an env: census versioned S3 tfstate objects (serial + resource-type counts) + cross-check CloudTrail; separates a real apply from a reverted one, identifies which variant of a stacked change ran, and tells untracked orphans from failed destroys

skills.name: wordpress-com-publish
skills.summary: Acquire a WordPress.com OAuth2 token (authorization-code flow) and publish/update posts via public-api.wordpress.com.

skills.name: work-on-pr
skills.summary: Author-side PR iteration loop.

skills.name: cmux-session-restore-forensics
skills.summary: Diagnose what cmux actually restored after a relaunch and recover panes it silently dropped.

skills.name: spring-profile-config-overlay-dedupe
skills.summary: Strip an application-<profile>.yml down to real overrides and prove the effective config is unchanged, by flattening base+profile before and after and diffing the key sets. Covers confirming profiles are layered at all, and when keeping a duplicate is correct.

skills.name: spa-request-capture-and-block
skills.summary: Capture the exact outbound request body a single-page app sends and block it before it leaves the browser: patch window.fetch AND XMLHttpRequest together (the XHR half is the one usually missed, so a fetch-only wrapper lets the request through), read the parsed payload off window, and disarm with a reload — including why a hash-route change does not remove the patch. For actions whose side effect costs credits or creates an irreversible record.

skills.name: us-federal-open-data-claim-verification
skills.summary: Check quantitative claims about US federal grants/awards/revenue against NIH RePORTER, USAspending and Treasury FiscalData; count-vs-dollars trap and testing 'every area' universals at subunit granularity.

skills.name: verbatim-social-post-retrieval
skills.summary: Retrieve exact original text of Truth Social / X posts (incl. deleted ones) for fact-checking: api.fxtwitter.com JSON, trumpstruth.org archive with its query= param and deletion flags, date-bounded negatives, HTTP 451 syndication fallback.

skills.name: chrome-localhost-mic-autoblock
skills.summary: Fix a web app's mic failing in Chrome with a not-allowed error on localhost even though the OS granted Chrome mic access: Chrome auto-blocks the mic per-site and the OS Privacy toggle / Chrome restart never clears it; set the site to Allow.

skills.name: metrics-zero-provenance-audit
skills.summary: Audit a multi-source metrics client before believing its zeros.

skills.name: archive-today-fetcher-hierarchy
skills.summary: Reach archive.today when automation is refused, cite it reproducibly, and send a truthful user agent.

skills.name: agent-host-skill-loading
skills.summary: Make a non-Claude, non-Codex agent host load skillz-format SKILL.md files: two-stage disclosure (menu line in the system prompt, body behind a load_skill tool) with the measured cost of each alternative, block-scalar-safe frontmatter parsing, ordered-path precedence with shadow reporting, refresh without restart and its turn-boundary gotcha, and why the reload belongs behind a privilege gate.

skills.name: litellm-custom-provider-dispatch-order
skills.summary: A LiteLLM CustomLLM provider that is registered correctly and still never runs: litellm.completion() dispatches through an if/elif chain in which seven branches match on the BARE MODEL NAME (open_ai_chat_completion_models and six more) before the custom-provider branch, so a custom row reusing a real upstream model id is captured earlier and silently billed to that vendor's API key. Covers the collision check, the namespaced-model fix, why custom_llm_setup() is a second required call that Router needs at construction time, and the assertion that proves the handler actually ran.

skills.name: secretsmanager-prove-no-consumer-before-destroy
skills.summary: Prove nothing consumes a Secrets Manager secret before a terraform destroy: per-resource CloudTrail lookup + GetSecretValue-vs-metadata classification, minus your own terraform refresh -- because a populated LastAccessedDate is NOT evidence of use (a secret with zero GetSecretValue still reports one)

skills.name: github-oidc-immutable-subject-claim
skills.summary: Diagnose a GitHub Actions job that cannot assume an AWS role by OIDC (`Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`) while every sibling repo in the same org assumes the same role fine -- GitHub now issues an immutable `sub` (`repo:ORG@ORG_ID/REPO@REPO_ID`) that a `repo:ORG/*` trust policy cannot match, per repo and depending on when it was created

skills.name: parallel-agent-session-collisions
skills.summary: Avoid duplicating, superseding, or clobbering work done by another agent session on the same repos: the three collision shapes, the pre-flight check for each, and how to reconcile. Also covers the collision that no artifact check can catch -- two sessions both about to do the same work, with nothing pushed for `gh pr list` to find -- detected by enumerating live peer sessions and asking directly, then split into named lanes with an explicit gate and the decision routed through the shared human.

skills.name: claude-code-cross-session-messaging
skills.summary: Talk to a Claude Code session that is already running via the native ListAgents + SendMessage pair instead of a headless `claude -p` call or a terminal-scraping bridge. Covers addressing (the name is the address; refs do not survive outside the listing that produced them), the idle-subscription primitive that replaces every polling loop, the no-TTY law that makes headless and in-process transports wedge silently rather than fail, multi-hop transport dependency failures, the per-session permission boundary that forbids delegating around your own denials, and the honest dividing line where a launch-a-callee tool is still the right answer.

skills.name: cmux-cross-session-visibility
skills.summary: Make agent-to-agent traffic visible to the human watching: a structured SendMessage envelope (kind + direction + topic in the summary field, plus a one-line header that survives raw transcripts) paired with a cmux sidebar status pill per workspace showing whether a session is waiting on a peer or owes one an answer. Covers why spawned teams are cross-workspace traffic by construction (tmux-compat maps a window to a workspace), why the pill key must not collide with cmux's own claude_code key, and the stale-pill failure mode plus every exit that must clear it.

skills.name: agent-traffic-log
skills.summary: An append-only JSONL event log of agent-to-agent traffic plus a live pane over it, giving a fleet an org-wide view instead of N private conversations. No daemon and no lock: concurrent appends are safe because a single write of under PIPE_BUF bytes to an O_APPEND descriptor cannot interleave, verified at 24 concurrent writers producing 960 lines with zero torn. Ships scripts/xs with log, tail, recent, status (who is waiting on whom, derived from events rather than tracked), and prune. Includes the acceptance test that only a real team run can satisfy.

skills.name: subagent-no-report-channel
skills.summary: Recover the work of a spawned subagent that finished but never reported, and tell that case apart from a genuinely wedged one. Root cause: an agent type's declared toolset may omit a messaging tool, so a correct, completed agent has no channel to deliver through -- or it is a forward-only wrapper scoped not to poll the background job it dispatched. Idle notifications are runtime-generated and are NOT evidence the agent's own send worked; the reliable oracle is the transcript (tool_use with no tool_result). Covers recovering the result from the agent's final text, from the job runtime's state directory, and the one-sentence fallback brief that prevents the loss.

skills.name: cmux-session-self-identity
skills.summary: Determine which cmux workspace, tab and surface a session is actually running in, and map other live sessions to theirs. Never answer from CMUX_* env vars: the tab and workspace variables can carry the same id (so tab identity is not in the environment at all), and on a resumed session they are a stale launch-time snapshot that can name a workspace the session has left. Uses the bundled CLI -- identify for the caller's own refs (read caller, not focused), tree --all --id-format both to resolve refs to names, top --all --processes to map pids to surfaces. Matters because a session that cannot name its own tab cannot tell a human which tab to address.

skills.name: git-simulate-sequential-merges
skills.summary: Determine which merges in a queue of N branches actually conflict, and preview the fully-merged file content, using merge-tree --write-tree chained through commit-tree - no refs, worktrees, index or working tree touched.

skills.name: terraform-noninteractive-prod-apply
skills.summary: Apply terraform to prod from a non-interactive context when the repo's apply.sh wrapper has no `-auto-approve` and blocks on the approval prompt -- use a saved plan file, not `echo yes |`, because a prompt-piped apply approves a plan terraform RECOMPUTES at that moment rather than the one you reviewed

skills.name: llm-vendor-waterfall
skills.summary: Serve one LLM call from an ordered list of vendors so a rate limit, a dead key, or an out-of-credits account fails over instead of failing the request. Covers the ordered-config to LiteLLM Router mapping, which Router knobs earn their keep (cooldown_time, allowed_fails, context_window_fallbacks, per-deployment budgets) and which to leave alone, the invisible dead fallback that reads as random flakiness, what must not be waterfalled, and how to prove failover actually happens.

skills.name: cmux-config-silent-drop-triage
skills.summary: Find out why a cmux.json entry that passes `cmux config doctor` never shows up in the palette, plus-button menu or tab bar. Doctor is syntax-only, the schema is additionalProperties: true, and the unified log stays silent - so the working oracles are a backup-diff bisect, the binary's own [CmuxConfig] diagnostics, and enum triads read straight off `strings`. Worked example: a workspaceCommand action hidden by `"restart": "restart"` (valid: ignore/confirm/recreate, or omit for a new workspace each time).

skills.name: alb-per-rule-traffic-attribution
skills.summary: Attribute ALB traffic to individual listener rules and callers: AWS/ApplicationELB has no rule-level dimension, and matched_rule_priority in access logs is a POSITION that renumbers when a rule is inserted, silently mislabelling any query spanning that deploy; attribute by request_url + user_agent instead

skills.name: cmux-claude-codex-cross-runtime-messaging
skills.summary: Run a Claude Code agent and a Codex CLI agent as messaging peers in cmux panes, each named as a tab and both in the agent traffic log. Codex has no SendMessage and Claude's peer socket needs auth, so the cross-runtime hop is keystroke injection (cmux send + send-key Enter) through a small helper that also logs to xs explicitly; each agent names its own tab first via cmux identify + tab-action rename. Covers the Codex TUI parking on a startup modal with no way to read its screen (diagnose from ~/.codex logs and the missing rollout file, inject one Enter), and where the lead, teammate and Codex transcripts live on disk afterwards. Verified 2026-08-27: five rounds in 50 s, every message exactly once.

skills.name: tamarian
skills.summary: Tamarian mode persona: Claude speaks as the Children of Tama - meaning carried by metaphor and allusion (canon ST:TNG phrases plus ones coined from Earth myth, history, and engineering lore), technical substance fully intact. Levels lite/full/ultra via /tamarian; code, commands, errors and numbers stay literal; security warnings and destructive-action confirmations always drop to plain speech. Ships LEXICON.md, a phrasebook with coinage rules.

collections.name: pr-loop
collections.summary: Paired PR-loop skills: work-on-pr (author) + review-pr-loop (reviewer). Legacy install.sh selector; prefer the pr-loop plugin entry.
